params.body:
People outside the team are to read the Observatory with their gentells.com account. gentells.com becomes where a person exists; the pipeline keeps only their role here. Design: `docs/design/one-account.md` (in this PR). The site and dashboard parts are separate PRs.

**Log in with gentells.com.** `GET /auth/site/config` gives the dashboard the authorize URL and client id. `POST /auth/site` exchanges the code (PKCE) at the site, reads `/api/observatory/me`, and decides:
- a team member (admin or member, matched on `site_user_id`, else email) keeps their role and is linked;
- a plan with the `observatory` ability gets role `guest` (a row `guest-<site id>`, no password);
- anything else, or blocked on the site, is refused.
Every failure is a no. A guest token lasts 12 hours; team tokens are unchanged, and the password login stays for the team.

**The guest only reads, and only what its screens need** (`packages/server/guest.mjs`). The probe and the guest share one read-only rule on the request (`isLookOnly`), so a new write route is closed to both without a list. Reads are an allowlist: 9 GET paths and 11 `/store/query` collections for Overview, Insights, Patterns, Signals, Concepts, Foresight, Standard and Atlas. Everything else, including any route added later, is 403: sources, mix, reports, ops, accounts, users, settings, evals, costs, Ask, the Studio.

**No passages from someone else's report.** Every JSON answer to a guest passes one wrapper that strips the passage fields (`raw_content`, `meta`, text, excerpt, quote and the like) from report signals, whatever the route; source name and title stay. Known gap: a `search` still matches report text, so a guest can learn which signals match a phrase without seeing it.

**Standing re-checked hourly.** A blocked account, a lapsed plan or a deleted account on the site ends the session within the hour, through the signed `GET /internal/accounts/{id}/observatory`. When the site is down the last answer holds until its hour is up, then the guest is refused.

Also: `users.site_user_id`; the offer knows the unlisted `observatory` plan (`listed: false`, fifth in the order); a guest's role cannot be changed by PATCH; `siteBase` honours `GENTELLS_SITE_URL`.

Tests: `test/guest-role.test.mjs` (18) covers the exchange with a stubbed site (team kept and linked, guest made, refused, blocked), guest writes and off-list reads refused, redaction for a guest and not for a member, and the lapsed re-check. Full suite 1299 of 1305; the 6 failures are report-render, which needs `pdftoppm`, not installed on the workbench.

On the box: `GENTELLS_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` (printed by the site's `gentells:observatory-client`), and `GENTELLS_SITE_URL=https://gentells.com` if the webhook URL's origin is not the site. `GENTELLS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is already set and is needed for the re-check.
params.title: Observatory access through gentells.com: site login and the guest role
